newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended unchanged at 42.05 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday in dull trading in the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open stable on Saturday after Friday's weekend, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 4.90 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
